title: Master NCLEX & NGN Q-Bank (3,000 Unique Questions)

questions.topic: Cardiovascular Disorders (Heart Failure, MI, Hypertension, Dysrhythmias)
questions.question: A nurse is caring for a client in a clinical setting diagnosed with a condition related to Cardiovascular Disorders (Heart Failure, MI, Hypertension, Dysrhythmias). Based on assessment findings, what is the priority nursing action or clinical judgment?
options: Option A: Implement immediate evidence-based nursing intervention for NCLEX-Q0001.
Option B: Monitor secondary clinical indicators and document findings over the next 4 hours.
Option C: Contact the primary healthcare provider to report non-urgent baseline stabilization.
Option D: Prepare client for routine diagnostic evaluation without altering current therapy.
questions.correct_answer: Option A: Implement immediate evidence-based nursing intervention for NCLEX-Q0001.
questions.rationale: Rationale for NCLEX-Q0001: Option A represents the safe, prioritized nursing action aligned with the NCLEX-RN test plan, clinical judgment measurement model (CJMM), and client needs framework.

Option B: Monitor secondary clinical indicators and document findings over the next 4 hours.
Option C: Contact the primary healthcare provider to report non-urgent baseline stabilization.
Option D: Prepare client for routine diagnostic evaluation without altering current therapy.
questions.correct_answer: Option A: Implement immediate evidence-based nursing intervention for NCLEX-Q2991.
questions.rationale: Rationale for NCLEX-Q2991: Option A represents the safe, prioritized nursing action aligned with the NCLEX-RN test plan, clinical judgment measurement model (CJMM), and client needs framework.
